title: Sweeping Regularization Strength Alpha
description: Evaluate and plot test RMSE for Ridge and Lasso models across several values of alpha.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Define a grid of candidate regularization strengths across the supplied range and initialize lists to store test RMSE values for Ridge and Lasso.
For each alpha, standardize the features, fit a Ridge regression model, predict on the test set, and record the resulting test RMSE.
Fit a standardized Lasso model with the same alpha and the supplied maximum iterations, then record its test RMSE.

steps.question: Why does the plot call plt.xscale("log")?
steps.answer: The positive candidate alphas span several orders of magnitude, so a logarithmic horizontal axis spaces them evenly.

steps.description: Plot the Ridge and Lasso test RMSE curves against alpha on a log scale, label the axes and title, and display the chart.
